title: This dish is really nice!
text: This dish is really nice!. I love this dish.  You get the benefits of baking with a stone without it being porous. Food doesn't really stick to it, but you can use non-stick spray if you want. It cleans very easily.  Goes from refrigerator to oven with no problem.
